askInstall: iOS Studio isn't installed yet. Install it now?
askDetail:
It changes only files in your home folder:
• copies iOS Studio to ~/.local/share/omarchy-ios-studio
• adds an app launcher entry, an icon and the ~/.local/bin/ios-studio command
• adds an Omarchy theme hook, so the window follows your theme
• adds a marked rule to ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua that keeps the window opaque, and reloads Hyprland (a backup is kept; Settings can remove it)
• makes its settings, state and cache folders
No system packages and no timers. Then Setup opens, which installs the iOS tools.
askUpdate: A newer iOS Studio came with the plugin update. Update it now?
askUpdateDetail: It moves ~/.local/share/omarchy-ios-studio forward to the plugin's version, copied from the plugin folder (nothing is downloaded). If that folder has changes of its own, it stops and changes nothing. Then it repairs the launcher entry, the ios-studio command, the theme hook and the Hyprland window rule, as the install did. Your settings, history and projects stay as they are. Reopen iOS Studio if it's open.
installingDetail: Copying iOS Studio and adding it to the app launcher.
updatingDetail: Updating iOS Studio from the plugin folder.
updateFailedDetail: iOS Studio couldn't be updated. Nothing was changed.
